text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Today is Valentine's Day. I saw the 
students excitedly handing out chocolates 
as tokens of their gratitude and 
affection.”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so this is where you were. I'm so glad 
I found you~.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Since today is Valentine's Day~ I have 
brought a gift befitting the occasion.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...I've caused you so much anxiety, after 
all. If you'd like, would you accept 
this?"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm glad. Well then~...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We have sweet and savory. Which would you 
like to start with?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufufu♪ The truth is~...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: How did it taste~?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Japanese sweets for Valentine's Day... 
Isn't that rather chic and tasteful?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It fills the stomach, and using seasonal 
flowers makes it both refined and pleasing 
to the eye...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You can enjoy both sweet and savory treats 
together, after all~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was completely sure it was chocolate, so 
I was naturally surprised, but—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Um. Was everything to your 
satisfaction?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Or would chocolate have been better after 
all, fitting for Valentine's?"
choice_data_list: It wasn't weird at all—it was delicious!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's the best news of all~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I didn't have time to make handmade ones 
for everyone else, so this was the least I 
could do...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I hope my feelings of gratitude have 
reached you, even just a little♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After enjoying the wagashi, Grass Wonder 
brewed a pleasantly bitter tea for us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an unusual Valentine's Day, yet 
elegant and refined in true Grass Wonder 
fashion.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Umm... did it perhaps not suit your taste?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You might not hear much about traditional 
Japanese sweets for Valentine's Day, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to make it something special, 
even if just a little..."
choice_data_list: I've gotta think of a return gift!
I need to think of a return gift!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Those words alone are 
more than enough of a reward.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...However, if I really may have 
something, I'd love Japanese sweets 
again."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"We can make something even fancier than 
today, and leisurely brew some tea..."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'd be so happy if we could spend time 
like this again...♪
